units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:7">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אפיק לון אריסא חדא פ׳ וכ׳</he> the tenant brought out one peach for them of which they and the drivers ate &c.; (<cite ref="Ketubot 112a:2">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite> <he>אַפַּרְסְקָא דהוה כאילפס וכ׳</he> a peach as large as a pot &c.); a. e.—Pl. <he>פִּרְסְקַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="Q01932"><he>פִּרְסִיקַ׳</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01746"><he>פִּירְ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:4:6">Y. Kil. I, 27ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מה נפיק מינהון קדריה פִּרְסְקַיָּה</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:4">Kil. I, 4</cite> <he>קירדו פרסיקיא</he> read <he>קרְוַיָּה</he> or <he>קַרְוֵי</he>) what comes out of them (nut engrafted on peach)? (Κάρυα περσικά) Persian walnuts (also called basilicæ nuces, v. <cite ref="Q01336"><he>פְּסַלְקָאוֹת</he></cite>).—[<cite ref="Chullin 141b">Ḥull. 141ᵇ</cite> <he>פרסקי</he>, v. next w.]
